name: youre-on-escrow-devnet
filter_function: <base64 of filter.js: npx tsx infra/quicknode/build-filter.ts --create-body https://<FLY_APP>.fly.dev>
notes: API-CONTRACT §5.1. Create / pause / resume / delete with scripts/qn-stream.ts (npm run qn-stream -- create --fly-app youre-on): it fills filter_function = base64(filter.js regenerated from the IDL), the webhook url and OUR destination_attributes.security_token, and drops this notes key.

security_token: generated once (>= 32 chars) into ~/.config/solana/youre-on/qn-stream.env (0600) unless QN_STREAM_SECURITY_TOKEN is set; it must equal the Fly secret QN_STREAM_SECURITY_TOKEN. The server verifies X-QN-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(token, X-QN-Nonce + X-QN-Timestamp + decompressed body), |now - ts| <= 300 s (apps/server/src/chain/quicknode.ts). qn-stream probes the webhook with a signed empty delivery before activating, since 3 failed retries auto-pause the Stream.
dataset_batch_size must be >= 5 (422 otherwise). filter_language: validate with npm run qn-stream -- test-filter --block <slot> first.
Pause the Stream when idle (~11 M credits/day at 24/7, shared with the RPC): npm run qn-stream -- pause <id>.
